capacity.availability.legacy: The report was created before forecasts existed. Add the queries and regenerate the report
capacity.availability.missing_series: The report data has no “{label}” series
capacity.error.missing_series: The report data has no “{label}” series. Add the query to “{domain}” and regenerate the report
capacity.error.missing_window: The report has no test interval
capacity.error.multiple_series: The “{label}” query returned several series. The forecast needs one series
capacity.error.not_applicable: A forecast is built only for step and stress tests
capacity.explain.bad_schema: The model answer does not match the analysis schema, fields: {fields}
capacity.explain.busy: This report is already being analysed
capacity.explain.no_json: The model answer has no JSON: “{excerpt}”
capacity.explain.no_limit: The data shows no limit, so there is nothing to analyse
capacity.explain.no_llm: No LLM provider is set up: Settings → LLM
capacity.explain.old_format: The analysis is in an old format: refresh it
capacity.explain.stale: The report data or the forecast settings changed after the analysis: refresh it
capacity.explain.too_often: You can analyse it again in {wait} s
capacity.nodes.no_query: Nodes not checked: the SLA has no node CPU query
capacity.nodes.no_series: Nodes not checked: the report data has no “{label}” series
capacity.note.p95_ms_to_s: p95 is stored in milliseconds; the forecast converted it to seconds
capacity.note.p95_no_points: The “{label}” query has no points before the RPS drop
capacity.note.p95_s_to_ms: p95 is stored in seconds; the forecast converted it to milliseconds
capacity.note.p95_unset: p95 is not assigned in the SLA: the forecast covers only the mean response time
capacity.note.vus_missing: VU series “{label}” not found: the chart shows only the calculated concurrency
capacity.note.vus_multiple: VU query “{label}” returned several series, so it is not used
capacity.plan.bad_unit: The “{label}” query returns values up to {peak}: it must be the instance CPU load as a fraction from 0 to 1, like process_cpu_usage
capacity.plan.no_query: Missing the service instance CPU query: {hint}
capacity.plan.no_series: The report data has no “{label}” series in the JVM domain: add the query and regenerate the report
capacity.plan.too_few_steps: The pod calculation needs at least {min} steps without stalls with CPU data; the report has {count}
capacity.scaling.no: Adding pods will not remove the cause
capacity.setting_hint: SLA criteria → Finding the maximum throughput
